summary_en: ¥30.0B buyback upper limit, 6,910,000 shares (10.55% of shares outstanding), ToSTNeT-3 method, execution window 24–26 August 2026. Rationale: strengthen shareholder returns and capital efficiency per capital-cost policy; offset share demand from concurrent equity offering.
summary_jp: 300億円上限、691万株（発行済10.55%）、ToSTNeT-3方式、2026年8月24～26日。資本コスト政策に基づく株主還元強化・資本効率向上、同時実施の売出しに伴う需給緩和。
